notes: Kit columns are the columns of combination A (the kit mask, the official design and the projection are defined in them). The 40 section bases are pegged into 8 strips of five (strips A-H, the kit's section column letters, 16 columns each), and strips into the three frames. A layout's x is the column as hung: display column = (kit column + column_shift) mod 128, where column_shift = 16 x the display position of strip A. strips lists the kit strips left to right as hung; groups lists the frames or frame parts left to right (2a = the left part of frame 2 in kit order, 2b = the right part); frame_order is the frame number of each group. A, B and C are the three combinations of the building instructions ("1 world - 3 combinations", pp. 7-8 and 139). D and E are not among them: a joint inside a frame uses the same 15 connector pegs as a joint between frames (pp. 134-139) and the white border is built once round the finished board (p. 140), so any rotation of the 8 strips by whole strips is buildable from one kit with no extra parts (7 strip joints x 15 + 8 strips x 4 x 3 = 201 of the 205 connector pegs). The grid spans 360 degrees of longitude (kit_31203_projection.json), so every seam is geographically continuous.
